items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: we had a fellow from Huntington was driving for us named Hale... he was driving the bus

ctx.x: And, uh, they, uh, when, band get there, and after we play, find out there's nothing coming, because Ross is back in, you know, Chicago somewhere. And, uh, he borrowed the money and moved no money from, for King. And we had to wait until Ross sent his money to go to the next town, to the next dance. Then there's something happened to the bus. Then we were in, um, Hunter from West Virginia. It went, uh, and the bus got really, really bad. It couldn't make mountains anymore. Mm-hmm. And, um, oh, just before then,…
